category_edits.rationale: Limit causal histories to the 30 most recent interactions in all four datasets, preserving chronological order and existing targets. Shorter context may reduce stale-preference interference and recurrent computation. Training and prediction use the same cap; the GRU, readout, loss and optimizer remain unchanged.

response.change_summary: Cap training, validation and generated prediction histories at 30 interactions, retaining dataset routing and one GRU checkpoint per category.
